housing.summary: Average 1-bedroom apartment in Burnaby city centre is approximately CAD 2,350/month per Numbeo (Jul 2026). BC landlords typically require first month's rent as security deposit (maximum allowed by law). Kijiji.ca and rentals.ca are the primary rental portals.

banking.summary: Major Canadian banks serve Burnaby. Newcomers need passport, immigration document (work/study permit or PR card), proof of BC address, and SIN if available. RBC and TD Bank offer newcomer banking packages. Burnaby is part of Metro Vancouver, with full access to all major bank branches.
required_docs: Immigration document (work permit, study permit, or PR card)

schools.summary: Burnaby is served by Burnaby Schools (School District 41), which offers French Immersion, International Baccalaureate (IB), and Mandarin Language Arts programs. The district also has an international student program and settlement workers in schools for newcomers.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers on work or study permits must notify IRCC of address changes via the IRCC portal. Permanent residents update SIN address with Service Canada. BC residents must exchange a foreign driving licence within 90 days of establishing BC residency via ICBC.
legal_admin.registration_step: Update address with IRCC at ircc.canada.ca if on work/study permit; permanent residents update SIN address at Service Canada.

tax_finance.summary: A Social Insurance Number (SIN) is Canada's tax identification number, issued by Service Canada. Required for work, tax filing, and government benefits. Apply at a Service Canada office or online.

transport.summary: Burnaby is served by TransLink (Metro Vancouver's transit authority), including SkyTrain (Millennium and Expo lines) and buses. Adult monthly pass (1-zone) is CAD 117.20 (as of July 1, 2026 fare increase). Foreign licence holders have 90 days to exchange to a BC licence via ICBC. BC MSP (Medical Services Plan) has a 3-month wait period for new arrivals from outside Canada.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Foreign licence holders must exchange to a BC licence within 90 days of establishing BC residency. Apply at an ICBC driver licensing office (icbc.com).
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for BC Medical Services Plan (MSP) as soon as you arrive. Coverage starts after a wait period of the remainder of the month of arrival plus two full months (approximately 3 months). Get private health insurance during the wait. Apply online at gov.bc.ca or at a ServiceBC location.
